title: 碎片大廈
summary: 碎片大廈由 Renzo Piano 設計、WSP 擔任結構設計、Mace 承建，官方高度 309.6 m、共 95 層。結構依用途分區：下部辦公層為複合鋼構，上部飯店與住宅層為 200 mm 後拉預力混凝土平板，塔頂以鋼構「散熱器」與桅桿收尾；中央混凝土核心筒是主要抗側骨幹，以費氏桁架與 A 形轉換調整柱距。英國首次採用由上而下的核心筒施工，讓核心筒在地下室開挖時同步上升。本課涵蓋分區質量、扭轉、預力樓板、轉換構件、由上而下施工、尖塔與塔吊、風洞、鄰近鐵路監測、帷幕牆與帽桁架的交接。
summaryEn: The Shard, designed by Renzo Piano with WSP as structural designer and Mace as contractor, is officially 309.6 m tall with 95 storeys. Its structure is zoned by use: composite steel for the lower offices, 200 mm post-tensioned concrete flat slabs for the hotel and homes above, and a steel radiator and mast at the crown; a central concrete core is the main lateral spine, with Vierendeel trusses and A-frames changing column spacing. It was the first UK use of top-down core construction, letting the core rise while the basement was being dug. The course covers zoned mass, torsion, post-tensioned slabs, transfer structures, top-down construction, spire and cranes, wind-tunnel testing, monitoring of adjacent rail assets, curtain-wall joints and the handover of hat trusses.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「混合用途分區與樓板系統」與「核心筒抗側與次核心抑制扭轉」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Mixed-use zoning and floor systems" and "Core lateral resistance and torsion control by a secondary core": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 混合用途分區與樓板系統：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Mixed-use zoning and floor systems: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「用途分區與樓板質量」如何影響碎片大廈的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Use zoning and floor mass” governs force, deformation or durability in “The Shard”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 設計者公開說明：下部辦公與零售層採複合鋼構，周邊到混凝土核心筒的跨度可達約 15 m，樓板梁為約 500 mm 深的組合斷面；上部飯店與住宅層改用 200 mm 厚後拉預力混凝土平板，跨度約 9 m、層高約 3.1 m；塔頂約 60 m 為鋼構「散熱器」，容納散熱設備並圍繞中央斜撐鋼桅。上部較重的混凝土樓板增加了高處的模態質量與阻尼，設計者因此認為不需要另設補充阻尼裝置。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「用途分區與樓板質量」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The designers explain that the lower office and retail floors are composite steel with spans of up to about 15 m from the perimeter to the concrete core and built-up floor beams about 500 mm deep; the hotel and residential floors above switch to 200 mm post-tensioned concrete flat slabs spanning about 9 m with a storey height of about 3.1 m; the top 60 m or so is a steel radiator housing heat-rejection plant around a central braced steel mast. The heavier concrete floors high up add modal mass and damping, which the designers considered sufficient to avoid supplementary damping devices. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Use zoning and floor mass” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：樓板自重：200 mm 預力平板 0.2×25 = 5.0 kPa；複合樓板等效厚 0.11 m×24 kN/m³ + 鋼梁 0.5 kPa ≈ 3.1 kPa，約 1.6 倍。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Floor self-weight: a 200 mm post-tensioned slab gives 0.2×25 = 5.0 kPa, while a composite slab with an equivalent 0.11 m thickness at 24 kN/m³ plus 0.5 kPa of steel gives about 3.1 kPa, so the post-tensioned slab is about 1.6 times heavier.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「樓板越輕越好，因為可以減少地震力與柱的負擔。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Lighter floors are always better because they reduce seismic force and column load." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「用途分區與樓板質量」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Use zoning and floor mass”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 混合用途分區與樓板系統
knowledge.text: 設計者公開說明：下部辦公與零售層採複合鋼構，周邊到混凝土核心筒的跨度可達約 15 m，樓板梁為約 500 mm 深的組合斷面；上部飯店與住宅層改用 200 mm 厚後拉預力混凝土平板，跨度約 9 m、層高約 3.1 m；塔頂約 60 m 為鋼構「散熱器」，容納散熱設備並圍繞中央斜撐鋼桅。上部較重的混凝土樓板增加了高處的模態質量與阻尼，設計者因此認為不需要另設補充阻尼裝置。
knowledge.textEn: The designers explain that the lower office and retail floors are composite steel with spans of up to about 15 m from the perimeter to the concrete core and built-up floor beams about 500 mm deep; the hotel and residential floors above switch to 200 mm post-tensioned concrete flat slabs spanning about 9 m with a storey height of about 3.1 m; the top 60 m or so is a steel radiator housing heat-rejection plant around a central braced steel mast. The heavier concrete floors high up add modal mass and damping, which the designers considered sufficient to avoid supplementary damping devices.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：樓板越輕越好，因為可以減少地震力與柱的負擔。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Lighter floors are always better because they reduce seismic force and column load. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「碎片大廈」的「混合用途分區與樓板系統：機制與傳力路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出載重來源、構件、接點與支承的傳力邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「高樓模型整合室」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與幾何版本、支承條件、荷載方向與獨立位移紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Mixed-use zoning and floor systems: mechanism and load path” in “The Shard”. Draw the load, member, connection and support load paths; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Tower model integration room” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for geometry revision, supports, load direction and independent displacement records, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「混合用途分區與樓板系統」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Mixed-use zoning and floor systems" is correct?
options: 樓板越輕越好，因為可以減少地震力與柱的負擔。
設計者公開說明：下部辦公與零售層採複合鋼構，周邊到混凝土核心筒的跨度可達約 15 m，樓板梁為約 500 mm 深的組合斷面。
只要核心筒位於平面中央，就不會有扭轉問題。
optionsEn: Lighter floors are always better because they reduce seismic force and column load.
The designers explain that the lower office and retail floors are composite steel with spans of up to about 15 m from the perimeter to the concrete core and built-up floor beams about 500 mm deep.
If the core is in the middle of the plan, there is no torsion problem.
quiz.explanation: 設計者公開說明：下部辦公與零售層採複合鋼構，周邊到混凝土核心筒的跨度可達約 15 m，樓板梁為約 500 mm 深的組合斷面；上部飯店與住宅層改用 200 mm 厚後拉預力混凝土平板，跨度約 9 m、層高約 3.1 m；塔頂約 60 m 為鋼構「散熱器」，容納散熱設備並圍繞中央斜撐鋼桅。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The designers explain that the lower office and retail floors are composite steel with spans of up to about 15 m from the perimeter to the concrete core and built-up floor beams about 500 mm deep; the hotel and residential floors above switch to 200 mm post-tensioned concrete flat slabs spanning about 9 m with a storey height of about 3.1 m; the top 60 m or so is a steel radiator housing heat-rejection plant around a central braced steel mast. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 混合用途分區與樓板系統：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Mixed-use zoning and floor systems: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「用途分區與樓板質量」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Use zoning and floor mass” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：樓板自重：200 mm 預力平板 0.2×25 = 5.0 kPa；複合樓板等效厚 0.11 m×24 kN/m³ + 鋼梁 0.5 kPa ≈ 3.1 kPa，約 1.6 倍。若上部樓板使第一模態廣義質量增加 20%，在相同風力與阻尼下共振加速度約降為 1/1.2 ≈ 83%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Floor self-weight: a 200 mm post-tensioned slab gives 0.2×25 = 5.0 kPa, while a composite slab with an equivalent 0.11 m thickness at 24 kN/m³ plus 0.5 kPa of steel gives about 3.1 kPa, so the post-tensioned slab is about 1.6 times heavier. If the upper floors raise the first-mode generalised mass by 20%, resonant acceleration under the same wind force and damping falls to about 1/1.2 ≈ 83%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在模型中分別以鋼構與混凝土樓板計算高處各層質量與第一、二模態的廣義質量，與風洞高頻力平衡試驗換算的加速度比較；完工後以環境振動量測頻率與阻尼，確認無補充阻尼的假設成立。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute storey masses and first- and second-mode generalised masses with steel and concrete floors in the model and compare the acceleration derived from high-frequency force-balance tests; after completion measure frequency and damping by ambient vibration to confirm that the no-supplementary-damping assumption holds.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 樓板自重：200 mm 預力平板 0.2×25 = 5.0 kPa；複合樓板等效厚 0.11 m×24 kN/m³ + 鋼梁 0.5 kPa ≈ 3.1 kPa，約 1.6 倍。若上部樓板使第一模態廣義質量增加 20%，在相同風力與阻尼下共振加速度約降為 1/1.2 ≈ 83%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Floor self-weight: a 200 mm post-tensioned slab gives 0.2×25 = 5.0 kPa, while a composite slab with an equivalent 0.11 m thickness at 24 kN/m³ plus 0.5 kPa of steel gives about 3.1 kPa, so the post-tensioned slab is about 1.6 times heavier. If the upper floors raise the first-mode generalised mass by 20%, resonant acceleration under the same wind force and damping falls to about 1/1.2 ≈ 83%. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「混合用途分區與樓板系統」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Mixed-use zoning and floor systems", which statement holds?
options: 沒有斜桿的費氏桁架承載力和有斜桿的桁架差不多。
塔吊的荷重只由塔吊自身的基礎承擔，與主結構無關。
樓板自重：200 mm 預力平板 0.2×25 = 5.0 kPa。
optionsEn: A Vierendeel truss without diagonals carries load about as well as a braced truss.
A tower crane's loads go only into its own base and have nothing to do with the main structure.

Floor self-weight: a 200 mm post-tensioned slab gives 0.2×25 = 5.0 kPa, while a composite slab with an equivalent 0.11 m thickness at 24 kN/m³ plus 0.5 kPa of steel gives about 3.1 kPa, so the post-tensioned slab is about 1.6 times heavier.
quiz.explanation: 樓板自重：200 mm 預力平板 0.2×25 = 5.0 kPa；複合樓板等效厚 0.11 m×24 kN/m³ + 鋼梁 0.5 kPa ≈ 3.1 kPa，約 1.6 倍。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Floor self-weight: a 200 mm post-tensioned slab gives 0.2×25 = 5.0 kPa, while a composite slab with an equivalent 0.11 m thickness at 24 kN/m³ plus 0.5 kPa of steel gives about 3.1 kPa, so the post-tensioned slab is about 1.6 times heavier. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 混合用途分區與樓板系統：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Mixed-use zoning and floor systems: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「用途分區與樓板質量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Use zoning and floor mass” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在模型中分別以鋼構與混凝土樓板計算高處各層質量與第一、二模態的廣義質量，與風洞高頻力平衡試驗換算的加速度比較；完工後以環境振動量測頻率與阻尼，確認無補充阻尼的假設成立。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute storey masses and first- and second-mode generalised masses with steel and concrete floors in the model and compare the acceleration derived from high-frequency force-balance tests; after completion measure frequency and damping by ambient vibration to confirm that the no-supplementary-damping assumption holds. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計基準應記錄各分區的樓板質量假設與其對加速度的影響，日後若變更用途（例如住宅改辦公）或大幅減輕裝修，須由結構工程師評估居住性。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The design basis should record the floor-mass assumption of each zone and its effect on acceleration, and any later change of use, such as residential to office, or major lightening of finishes requires the structural engineer to reassess habitability.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若上部改用較輕的樓板或大幅減少隔間與裝修質量而未重新評估，高處加速度可能上升到住宅與飯店的舒適度門檻以上；不同樓板系統的交界層若勁度與質量突變未處理，也容易出現樓板裂縫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Switching upper floors to lighter construction or greatly reducing partitions and finishes without re-evaluation can raise upper-level accelerations above residential and hotel comfort limits; abrupt stiffness and mass changes at the interface between floor systems also invite slab cracking if not addressed. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在模型中分別以鋼構與混凝土樓板計算高處各層質量與第一、二模態的廣義質量，與風洞高頻力平衡試驗換算的加速度比較；完工後以環境振動量測頻率與阻尼，確認無補充阻尼的假設成立。
knowledge.textEn: Compute storey masses and first- and second-mode generalised masses with steel and concrete floors in the model and compare the acceleration derived from high-frequency force-balance tests; after completion measure frequency and damping by ambient vibration to confirm that the no-supplementary-damping assumption holds.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計基準應記錄各分區的樓板質量假設與其對加速度的影響，日後若變更用途（例如住宅改辦公）或大幅減輕裝修，須由結構工程師評估居住性。
knowledge.textEn: The design basis should record the floor-mass assumption of each zone and its effect on acceleration, and any later change of use, such as residential to office, or major lightening of finishes requires the structural engineer to reassess habitability.

quiz.question: 要驗證「混合用途分區與樓板系統」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Mixed-use zoning and floor systems"?
options: 在模型中分別以鋼構與混凝土樓板計算高處各層質量與第一、二模態的廣義質量，與風洞高頻力平衡試驗換算的加速度比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要擋土牆夠強，開挖就不會影響鄰近的鐵路設施。
optionsEn: Compute storey masses and first- and second-mode generalised masses with steel and concrete floors in the model and compare the acceleration derived from high-frequency force-balance tests.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If the retaining wall is strong enough, excavation cannot affect nearby rail assets.
quiz.explanation: 在模型中分別以鋼構與混凝土樓板計算高處各層質量與第一、二模態的廣義質量，與風洞高頻力平衡試驗換算的加速度比較；完工後以環境振動量測頻率與阻尼，確認無補充阻尼的假設成立。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compute storey masses and first- and second-mode generalised masses with steel and concrete floors in the model and compare the acceleration derived from high-frequency force-balance tests; after completion measure frequency and damping by ambient vibration to confirm that the no-supplementary-damping assumption holds. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 混合用途分區與樓板系統：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Mixed-use zoning and floor systems: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「用途分區與樓板質量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Use zoning and floor mass” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若上部改用較輕的樓板或大幅減少隔間與裝修質量而未重新評估，高處加速度可能上升到住宅與飯店的舒適度門檻以上；不同樓板系統的交界層若勁度與質量突變未處理，也容易出現樓板裂縫。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Switching upper floors to lighter construction or greatly reducing partitions and finishes without re-evaluation can raise upper-level accelerations above residential and hotel comfort limits; abrupt stiffness and mass changes at the interface between floor systems also invite slab cracking if not addressed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：上部較重的混凝土樓板增加了高處的模態質量與阻尼，設計者因此認為不需要另設補充阻尼裝置。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The heavier concrete floors high up add modal mass and damping, which the designers considered sufficient to avoid supplementary damping devices.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「樓板越輕越好，因為可以減少地震力與柱的負擔。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Lighter floors are always better because they reduce seismic force and column load." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若上部改用較輕的樓板或大幅減少隔間與裝修質量而未重新評估，高處加速度可能上升到住宅與飯店的舒適度門檻以上；不同樓板系統的交界層若勁度與質量突變未處理，也容易出現樓板裂縫。
knowledge.textEn: Switching upper floors to lighter construction or greatly reducing partitions and finishes without re-evaluation can raise upper-level accelerations above residential and hotel comfort limits; abrupt stiffness and mass changes at the interface between floor systems also invite slab cracking if not addressed.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「混合用途分區與樓板系統」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Mixed-use zoning and floor systems" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若上部改用較輕的樓板或大幅減少隔間與裝修質量而未重新評估，高處加速度可能上升到住宅與飯店的舒適度門檻以上。
只要核心筒位於平面中央，就不會有扭轉問題。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Switching upper floors to lighter construction or greatly reducing partitions and finishes without re-evaluation can raise upper-level accelerations above residential and hotel comfort limits.
If the core is in the middle of the plan, there is no torsion problem.
quiz.explanation: 若上部改用較輕的樓板或大幅減少隔間與裝修質量而未重新評估，高處加速度可能上升到住宅與飯店的舒適度門檻以上；不同樓板系統的交界層若勁度與質量突變未處理，也容易出現樓板裂縫。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Switching upper floors to lighter construction or greatly reducing partitions and finishes without re-evaluation can raise upper-level accelerations above residential and hotel comfort limits; abrupt stiffness and mass changes at the interface between floor systems also invite slab cracking if not addressed. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 核心筒抗側與次核心抑制扭轉：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Core lateral resistance and torsion control by a secondary core: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「背包次核心與扭轉」如何影響碎片大廈的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Backpack secondary core and torsion” governs force, deformation or durability in “The Shard”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 中央混凝土核心筒剪力牆是主要的抗側骨幹，飯店與住宅層另加翼牆提高核心勁度；頂部機械層的外伸帽桁架用於改善風作用下的使用性。塔樓低層一側附有被稱為「背包」的低層附屬量體，其中設有次核心，用來減少主核心承受的扭轉。當風力合力或質量中心與剛心不重合時，樓層會繞剛心旋轉，角落位移比中心大；在偏心側增加剪力牆，相當於增大扭轉勁度並拉近剛心與質心。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「背包次核心與扭轉」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The central concrete core shear walls are the main lateral spine, with wing walls added at hotel and residential levels to stiffen the core, and outrigger hat trusses in the upper plant levels improve wind serviceability. A low-rise annex called the Backpack attaches to one side at the lower levels, and its secondary core reduces torsion on the main core. When the wind resultant or centre of mass does not coincide with the centre of stiffness, floors rotate about the stiffness centre and corners move more than the middle; adding shear walls on the eccentric side raises torsional stiffness and draws the centres together. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Backpack secondary core and torsion” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：扭矩 T = F·e，轉角 θ = T/K_T，角落位移 = θ·r。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Torque T = F·e, rotation θ = T/K_T and corner displacement = θ·r.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要核心筒位於平面中央，就不會有扭轉問題。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the core is in the middle of the plan, there is no torsion problem." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「背包次核心與扭轉」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Backpack secondary core and torsion”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 核心筒抗側與次核心抑制扭轉
knowledge.titleEn: Core lateral resistance and torsion control by a secondary core
knowledge.text: 中央混凝土核心筒剪力牆是主要的抗側骨幹，飯店與住宅層另加翼牆提高核心勁度；頂部機械層的外伸帽桁架用於改善風作用下的使用性。塔樓低層一側附有被稱為「背包」的低層附屬量體，其中設有次核心，用來減少主核心承受的扭轉。
knowledge.textEn: The central concrete core shear walls are the main lateral spine, with wing walls added at hotel and residential levels to stiffen the core, and outrigger hat trusses in the upper plant levels improve wind serviceability. A low-rise annex called the Backpack attaches to one side at the lower levels, and its secondary core reduces torsion on the main core.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要核心筒位於平面中央，就不會有扭轉問題。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the core is in the middle of the plan, there is no torsion problem. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「核心筒抗側與次核心抑制扭轉」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Core lateral resistance and torsion control by a secondary core" is correct?
options: 只要核心筒位於平面中央，就不會有扭轉問題。
後拉預力樓板和一般鋼筋混凝土樓板一樣，可以隨意鑽孔。
中央混凝土核心筒剪力牆是主要的抗側骨幹，飯店與住宅層另加翼牆提高核心勁度；頂部機械層的外伸帽桁架用於改善風作用下的使用性。
optionsEn: If the core is in the middle of the plan, there is no torsion problem.
A post-tensioned slab can be drilled anywhere, just like ordinary reinforced concrete.

The central concrete core shear walls are the main lateral spine, with wing walls added at hotel and residential levels to stiffen the core, and outrigger hat trusses in the upper plant levels improve wind serviceability.
quiz.explanation: 中央混凝土核心筒剪力牆是主要的抗側骨幹，飯店與住宅層另加翼牆提高核心勁度；頂部機械層的外伸帽桁架用於改善風作用下的使用性。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The central concrete core shear walls are the main lateral spine, with wing walls added at hotel and residential levels to stiffen the core, and outrigger hat trusses in the upper plant levels improve wind serviceability. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 核心筒抗側與次核心抑制扭轉：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Core lateral resistance and torsion control by a secondary core: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「背包次核心與扭轉」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Backpack secondary core and torsion” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：扭矩 T = F·e，轉角 θ = T/K_T，角落位移 = θ·r。F = 20,000 kN、偏心 e = 5 m，T = 100,000 kN·m；主核心 K_T = 2.0×10⁸ kN·m/rad 時 θ = 5.0×10⁻⁴ rad，r = 30 m 的角落位移 15 mm；次核心使 K_T 增為 2.5×10⁸，θ = 4.0×10⁻⁴ rad，角落位移 12 mm，減少 20%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Torque T = F·e, rotation θ = T/K_T and corner displacement = θ·r. With F = 20,000 kN and e = 5 m, T = 100,000 kN·m; a main-core K_T = 2.0×10⁸ kN·m/rad gives θ = 5.0×10⁻⁴ rad and 15 mm at a corner r = 30 m away; a secondary core raising K_T to 2.5×10⁸ gives θ = 4.0×10⁻⁴ rad and 12 mm, 20% less. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以三維模型計算各層質心與剛心的偏心距、扭轉模態週期與參與質量，比較有無次核心的角落位移；風洞試驗需提供扭矩頻譜，確認角落加速度在居住性準則內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use the three-dimensional model to compute the eccentricity between centres of mass and stiffness at each level, torsional periods and participating mass, comparing corner displacements with and without the secondary core; the wind-tunnel test must supply torque spectra to confirm corner accelerations meet habitability criteria.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 扭矩 T = F·e，轉角 θ = T/K_T，角落位移 = θ·r。F = 20,000 kN、偏心 e = 5 m，T = 100,000 kN·m；主核心 K_T = 2.0×10⁸ kN·m/rad 時 θ = 5.0×10⁻⁴ rad，r = 30 m 的角落位移 15 mm；次核心使 K_T 增為 2.5×10⁸，θ = 4.0×10⁻⁴ rad，角落位移 12 mm，減少 20%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Torque T = F·e, rotation θ = T/K_T and corner displacement = θ·r. With F = 20,000 kN and e = 5 m, T = 100,000 kN·m; a main-core K_T = 2.0×10⁸ kN·m/rad gives θ = 5.0×10⁻⁴ rad and 15 mm at a corner r = 30 m away; a secondary core raising K_T to 2.5×10⁸ gives θ = 4.0×10⁻⁴ rad and 12 mm, 20% less. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「核心筒抗側與次核心抑制扭轉」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Core lateral resistance and torsion control by a secondary core", which statement holds?
options: 扭矩 T = F·e，轉角 θ = T/K_T，角落位移 = θ·r。
由上而下施工只是把工序倒過來，對結構設計沒有影響。
大樓擺動 300 至 400 mm 就表示結構有安全疑慮。
optionsEn: Torque T = F·e, rotation θ = T/K_T and corner displacement = θ·r.
Top-down construction merely reverses the order of work and does not affect structural design.
A tower swaying 300 to 400 mm means it is structurally unsafe.
quiz.explanation: 扭矩 T = F·e，轉角 θ = T/K_T，角落位移 = θ·r。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Torque T = F·e, rotation θ = T/K_T and corner displacement = θ·r. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 核心筒抗側與次核心抑制扭轉：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Core lateral resistance and torsion control by a secondary core: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「背包次核心與扭轉」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Backpack secondary core and torsion” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以三維模型計算各層質心與剛心的偏心距、扭轉模態週期與參與質量，比較有無次核心的角落位移；風洞試驗需提供扭矩頻譜，確認角落加速度在居住性準則內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use the three-dimensional model to compute the eccentricity between centres of mass and stiffness at each level, torsional periods and participating mass, comparing corner displacements with and without the secondary core; the wind-tunnel test must supply torque spectra to confirm corner accelerations meet habitability criteria. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：對有附屬量體或不對稱收分的塔樓，設計報告應逐層列出偏心距與扭轉不規則判定，並說明次核心或翼牆的配置理由；施工中次核心與主核心的連接樓板須按順序完成。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For towers with annexes or asymmetric tapering, the design report should list eccentricity and torsional-irregularity checks floor by floor and justify the secondary core or wing walls; floors linking secondary and main cores must be completed in the planned sequence.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若忽略低層附屬量體造成的偏心，主核心牆角落與連梁會在風下承受額外剪力與扭轉應力而開裂；角落帷幕牆的層間變位也會大於設計值，造成密封失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring the eccentricity created by a low-rise annex loads the corners and coupling beams of the main core with extra shear and torsional stress that can crack them, and corner curtain walls see larger inter-storey movements than designed, causing seal failures. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以三維模型計算各層質心與剛心的偏心距、扭轉模態週期與參與質量，比較有無次核心的角落位移；風洞試驗需提供扭矩頻譜，確認角落加速度在居住性準則內。
knowledge.textEn: Use the three-dimensional model to compute the eccentricity between centres of mass and stiffness at each level, torsional periods and participating mass, comparing corner displacements with and without the secondary core; the wind-tunnel test must supply torque spectra to confirm corner accelerations meet habitability criteria.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 對有附屬量體或不對稱收分的塔樓，設計報告應逐層列出偏心距與扭轉不規則判定，並說明次核心或翼牆的配置理由；施工中次核心與主核心的連接樓板須按順序完成。
knowledge.textEn: For towers with annexes or asymmetric tapering, the design report should list eccentricity and torsional-irregularity checks floor by floor and justify the secondary core or wing walls; floors linking secondary and main cores must be completed in the planned sequence.

quiz.question: 要驗證「核心筒抗側與次核心抑制扭轉」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Core lateral resistance and torsion control by a secondary core"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以三維模型計算各層質心與剛心的偏心距、扭轉模態週期與參與質量，比較有無次核心的角落位移；風洞試驗需提供扭矩頻譜，確認角落加速度在居住性準則內。
帷幕牆只需要承受風壓，不必考慮結構變位。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.

Use the three-dimensional model to compute the eccentricity between centres of mass and stiffness at each level, torsional periods and participating mass, comparing corner displacements with and without the secondary core.
A curtain wall only needs to resist wind pressure, not structural movement.

steps.title: 核心筒抗側與次核心抑制扭轉：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Core lateral resistance and torsion control by a secondary core: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「背包次核心與扭轉」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Backpack secondary core and torsion” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若忽略低層附屬量體造成的偏心，主核心牆角落與連梁會在風下承受額外剪力與扭轉應力而開裂；角落帷幕牆的層間變位也會大於設計值，造成密封失效。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring the eccentricity created by a low-rise annex loads the corners and coupling beams of the main core with extra shear and torsional stress that can crack them, and corner curtain walls see larger inter-storey movements than designed, causing seal failures. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：當風力合力或質量中心與剛心不重合時，樓層會繞剛心旋轉，角落位移比中心大；在偏心側增加剪力牆，相當於增大扭轉勁度並拉近剛心與質心。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: When the wind resultant or centre of mass does not coincide with the centre of stiffness, floors rotate about the stiffness centre and corners move more than the middle; adding shear walls on the eccentric side raises torsional stiffness and draws the centres together.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要核心筒位於平面中央，就不會有扭轉問題。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the core is in the middle of the plan, there is no torsion problem." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若忽略低層附屬量體造成的偏心，主核心牆角落與連梁會在風下承受額外剪力與扭轉應力而開裂；角落帷幕牆的層間變位也會大於設計值，造成密封失效。
knowledge.textEn: Ignoring the eccentricity created by a low-rise annex loads the corners and coupling beams of the main core with extra shear and torsional stress that can crack them, and corner curtain walls see larger inter-storey movements than designed, causing seal failures.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.questionEn: When "Core lateral resistance and torsion control by a secondary core" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
